camel_example: aliyun rds CreateDBProxyEndpointAddress --region cn-hangzhou --DBProxyEndpointId ta9um40000 --DBInstanceId 'rm-t4n30000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DBProxyConnectStringNetType Public --ConnectionStringPrefix test1234
description_en: Creates the endpoint that is used to connect to the dedicated proxy of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于新增RDS实例数据库代理的连接地址
kebab_example: aliyun rds create-db-proxy-endpoint-address --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id rm-t4n30000 --db-proxy-endpoint-id ta9um40000 --connection-string-prefix test1234 --db-proxy-connect-string-net-type Public --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDBProxyEndpointAddress

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The proxy endpoint ID. You can call the DescribeDBProxyEndpoint operation to query the proxy endpoint ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据库代理连接地址ID。可以调用DescribeDBProxyEndpoint接口查询
parameters.name: db_proxy_endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: The prefix of the proxy endpoint Enter a custom prefix
parameters.help_zh: 新的数据库代理连接地址的前缀。自定义
parameters.name: connection_string_prefix

parameters.help_en:
The port number that is associated with the proxy endpoint.

If the instance runs MySQL, the default value is 3306.
If the instance runs PostgreSQL, the default value is 5432
parameters.help_zh:
新的数据库代理连接地址的端口，默认值：

MySQL：3306
PostgreSQL：5432
parameters.name: db_proxy_new_connect_string_port

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the proxy endpoint. Valid values:

Public: Internet
VPC: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
Classic: classic network

Default value: Classic
parameters.help_zh:
新的数据库代理连接地址的网络类型，取值：
Public：公网
VPC（默认值）：专有网络
parameters.name: db_proxy_connect_string_net_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the VPC to which the proxy endpoint belongs. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the information.

This parameter must be specified when DBProxyConnectStringNetType is set to VPC
parameters.help_zh:
新的数据库代理连接地址的VPC ID。可调用DescribeDBInstanceAttribute接口查询。

当DBProxyConnectStringNetType取值为VPC时， 必须传入此参数
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch that is associated with the specified VPC. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the vSwitch ID.

This parameter must be specified when DBProxyConnectStringNetType is set to VPC
parameters.help_zh:
新的数据库代理连接地址的虚拟交换机ID。可调用DescribeDBInstanceAttribute接口查询。

当DBProxyConnectStringNetType取值为VPC时， 必须传入此参数
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: db_proxy_engine_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
